facts.text: The hotel sits at the edge of the Chateau de Versailles gardens and has occupied its site since 1910.
facts.excerpt: Just at the edge of the Chateau de Versailles gardens, the Trianon Palace has occupied a prime piece of real estate since 1910.

facts.text: The Trianon Palace's architect, René Sergent, also designed the Savoy and Claridge's hotels in London.
facts.excerpt: Its architect René Sergent was also the mastermind behind the

facts.text: The architecture takes its inspiration from the Grand Trianon at Versailles.
facts.excerpt: The architecture takes its inspiration from the Grand Trianon, the pink-marble hideaway built by the Louis XIV as an escape from confining courtly life.

facts.text: The Salon Clemenceau, the hotel's historic ballroom, hosted the official delegations working out the details of the Treaty of Versailles in 1919.
facts.excerpt: The Salon Clemenceau, the historic gold-etched ballroom, illuminated by crystal chandeliers, was the site of the official delegations for hammering out the details of the Treaty of Versailles in 1919.

facts.text: The hotel has two sections: the five-star Trianon Palace and the four-star Pavillon du Trianon.
facts.excerpt: guests will have the choice of two sections, Trianon Palace and Pavillon du Trianon

facts.text: The Trianon Palace building features neoclassical architecture and a grand gallery filled with daylight.
facts.excerpt: The Trianon Palace is a 5 star venue featuring majestic neoclassical architecture and opulent décor. Discover our grand gallery filled with daylight

facts.text: The restaurants, bar, spa and swimming pool are all in the Palace building, reached from the Pavillon by a dedicated pathway.
facts.excerpt: The restaurants, bar, spa, and swimming pool are located in the Palace building, which is easily accessible through a dedicated pathway.

facts.text: Most Pavillon du Trianon rooms overlook the hotel's gardens.
facts.excerpt: The Pavillon is a 4 star building accommodating 99 rooms, most of which overlook the hotel’s stunning gardens.

facts.text: Palace suites have a separate living area and views of the Chateau and its Royal Domain.
facts.excerpt: Relax with a separate living area and views of the Chateau and its Royal Domain.

facts.text: Terrace Suites are tucked under the roof on the sixth floor.
facts.excerpt: Special shout-out to the Terrace Suites, tucked under the roof on the sixth floor.

facts.text: Rooms have mosaic-tiled marble bathrooms with heated floors.
facts.excerpt: mosaic-tiled marble bathrooms with heated floors

facts.text: Gordon Ramsay au Trianon is a Michelin-starred restaurant serving French cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Our Michelin-starred restaurant Gordon Ramsay au Trianon provides a feast for the senses. Discover delectable French cuisine in an elegant and intimate setting.

facts.text: La Véranda brasserie serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with continental cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, La Véranda brasserie offers exquisite continental cuisine

facts.text: In warmer months, La Véranda's terrace has a view of the Palace of Versailles.
facts.excerpt: During the warmer months, ask for a table on the terrace to enjoy the beautiful view of the Palace of Versailles.

facts.text: Peacock Alley serves afternoon tea and a wide selection of wines.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy afternoon tea, a wide selection of wines, plus a warm and relaxing atmosphere at Peacock Alley.

facts.text: The hotel's culinary duo is Executive Chef Frédéric Larquemin and Pastry Chef Eddie Benghanem.
facts.excerpt: Learn more about Executive Chef Frédéric Larquemin and Pastry Chef Eddie Benghanem

facts.text: The Guerlain spa's treatment rooms are arranged around a glass-roofed swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: treatment rooms are oriented around the glass-roofed swimming pool

facts.text: There is a kids club for younger guests.
facts.excerpt: There’s also a well-equipped kids club to keep younger guests entertained.

facts.text: Guests can walk directly from the hotel into the Chateau de Versailles gardens.
facts.excerpt: Walking directly into the Chateau de Versailles gardens from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is 10km from the Golf National.
facts.excerpt: Located 10km from the Golf National

facts.text: The hotel has a conference center for corporate meetings and events.
facts.excerpt: there’s a well-equipped conference center staging corporate meetings and events

facts.text: Room service is available 24/7, with a limited menu from 11 p.m.
facts.excerpt: Available 24/7 with a limited menu from 11 p.m.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as 20 minutes from Paris.
facts.excerpt: A dose of fresh country air just 20 minutes from Paris

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler advises requesting a garden- or park-facing room in the historic hotel rather than the newer annex.
facts.excerpt: Request a garden or park-facing room in the historic hotel and not the newer annex.

facts.text: The Guerlain spa is described as one of the largest hotel spas in Europe.
